text:
deploy-bot: starting phased rollout v3.12 -> US slice (1/3). canary 5% -> monitor for 20m. pin=service@v3.12.1 :rocket:

maria.gomez: ✅ ack. what's current warm pool in us-east? any pre-warm failures last hour?

cheng.li: us-east warm pool=72 GPUs (target 80). last hour 2 pre-warm failures (OOM on init) but they recovered during autoscale. logs: `prewarm.init.timeout` x2.

olivia.k: latency p50 85ms -> baseline 82ms, p95 unchanged. no errors yet. dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/rollouts/v3.12

samir: @cheng.li those OOMs worry me for EU slice — can we validate image+quant config before EU?

cheng.li: will run a quick smoke deploy to eu-canary pool now, no traffic. posting result in 10m.

deploy-bot: eu-canary smoke job started by cheng.li. command:
```
/deploy smoke --region=eu-central --image=service:v3.12.1 --no-traffic
```

leo.ops: if smoke passes, we should still increase eu warm_pool by +20 for canary window. EU has historically lower spare capacity.

kate-sre: change window reminder — release window 08:00-12:00 UTC. keep APAC hold until EU passes. any objections? :eyes: 

maria.gomez: +1 on holding APAC. prefer sequential: US -> EU -> APAC. if EU needs rollback, we avoid cross-region cascading issues.

cheng.li: smoke done. result: init ok, no OOMs. kernel mismatches noted in 2 hosts but they auto-selected fallback kernels. logs:
```
[ok] host-42: fallback-kernel used
[ok] host-87: fallback-kernel used
```

olivia.k: running canary traffic to EU now at 3%. watching errors and token-per-second.

deploy-bot: eu-canary traffic ramp to 3% complete. monitoring window 15m.

(10m passes)

olivia.k: EU canary error rate spiked to 1.9% (baseline 0.2%). errors are 502 gateway on `kv-cache` fills. stacktrace shortlinks: https://redwood.internal/err/EE-502-213

samir: hold EU rollout. rollback EU canary to v3.11 and investigate kv-cache eviction logic. rollback command:
```
/deploy rollback --region=eu-central --to=service@v3.11.4 --reason="kv-cache 502 spike"
```
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for eu-central per samir. ETA 3m for traffic cutover. :hammer:

leo.ops: good catch. APAC stays blocked. US continues at slice 1/3 but throttle to 50% of planned until EU stable. update autoscale policy to be more conservative for cross-region spikes.

maria.gomez: please add release-note blurb about kv-cache regression and rollback. I'll draft: "Rolled back v3.12 in EU due to increased 502s from kv-cache eviction under canary load. Fix in progress; APAC rollout paused."

kate-sre: tagging oncall for postmortem if we see recurrence: @kate-sre @samir. also open incident if >2% persists beyond 30m.

cheng.li: creating PR with improved eviction thresholds and better logging. will link in thread when ready.

olivia.k: post-rollback EU metrics trending back to baseline. EU error rate 0.3% after rollback.

maria.gomez: decision summary: keep APAC on hold; US slice remains but throttled (50%); EU rolled back to v3.11; next steps: cheng to put fix PR, smoke test, then small EU canary reattempt. i'll update the release notes and notify comms. :white_check_mark:
